Container.Name: manta
Container.Overview: Manta: Hardened, reproducible GNU Guix + zero-dependency Rust Caddy v2 Reverse Proxy & CrowdSec AppSec WAF Bouncer appliance for the media stack (Emby, Jellyfin, Seerr, and *arr). Enforces Cloudflare trusted proxy CIDRs, HSTS/security headers, Swagger/OpenAPI 403 lockdown, and live Caddyfile auto-reload.

Config.Name: HTTP Reverse Proxy Port
Config.Description: Primary HTTP Reverse Proxy Port (mapped to 8280 by default for side-by-side testing with existing Caddy)

Config.Name: Secondary HTTP Port
Config.Description: Secondary HTTP Reverse Proxy Port (e.g. direct Jellyfin/Tailscale listener)

Config.Name: Health & WAF Status API
Config.Description: JSON Health, Caddy & CrowdSec LAPI/AppSec Status API (/status)

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent Caddy configuration directory (and optional user Caddyfile or caddy.env)

Config.Name: AppData Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent Caddy data & certificate storage directory

Config.Name: Access Logs Path
Config.Description: Structured JSON access log directory for CrowdSec parsing

Config.Name: CrowdSec Bouncer API Key
Config.Description: CrowdSec LAPI bouncer API key required for real-time IP & AppSec WAF decisions

Config.Name: CrowdSec LAPI URL
Config.Description: CrowdSec Local API (LAPI) endpoint URL

Config.Name: CrowdSec AppSec WAF URL
Config.Description: CrowdSec AppSec WAF engine endpoint URL

Config.Name: Extra Trusted Proxy CIDRs
Config.Description: Space or comma-separated local/Tailscale trusted proxy CIDRs (merged automatically with all 22 Cloudflare IPv4/IPv6 ranges)

Config.Name: Emby Domain(s)
Config.Description: Caddy site address(es) for Emby reverse proxy

Config.Name: Emby Upstream
Config.Description: Emby backend host:port

Config.Name: Jellyfin Domain(s)
Config.Description: Caddy site address(es) for Jellyfin reverse proxy

Config.Name: Jellyfin Upstream
Config.Description: Jellyfin backend host:port

Config.Name: Seerr Domain(s)
Config.Description: Caddy site address(es) for Seerr reverse proxy

Config.Name: Seerr Upstream
Config.Description: Seerr backend host:port

Config.Name: Drop Privileges (Unprivileged Caddy)
Config.Description: Run Caddy as unprivileged PUID/PGID (set true when binding ports >=1024 or with CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unprivileged user UID (Unraid nobody=99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Unprivileged group GID (Unraid users=100)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation umask (002 = 775 dirs / 664 files)
